about.title: About AWS Student Builder Group - GCES
about.description: AWS Student Builder Group - GCES is a student-led technical community dedicated to empowering students through cloud computing education, hands-on learning, and industry engagement. The group organizes workshops, technical sessions, networking events, and collaborative initiatives that help students build practical skills and prepare for careers in cloud computing and emerging technologies.
about.vision: To create a thriving community of students equipped with cloud computing knowledge, innovation, and technical excellence while fostering the next generation of technology leaders in cloud and AI.
mission: Promote awareness of cloud technologies, AI, and new technologies among students.
Bridge the gap between academia and industry.
Encourage practical learning through workshops and technical events.
Support students in pursuing globally recognized AWS learning pathways and certifications.
objectives: Introduce students to cloud computing concepts.
Build awareness of AWS technologies, cloud platforms, new technologies, and AI.

features.title: Cloud and AWS foundations
features.description: Beginner-friendly learning around AWS services, cloud concepts, hosting, storage, compute, and modern infrastructure.

features.title: AI and emerging technologies

features.title: Hands-on builder culture
features.description: Workshops, technical events, peer demos, and collaborative initiatives that turn curiosity into practical skill.

join.title: Ready to Build with community?
